description: Source code for PeripheralController class managing input device lights, batteries, and related functionalities in Android's input system.

classes.name: PeripheralController
classes.description: Manages input device peripherals such as lights and batteries, providing APIs to query and set their states.

classes.name: PeripheralController::Light
classes.description: Base class for different types of input device lights.

classes.name: PeripheralController::MonoLight
classes.description: Represents a mono-color light, allowing setting and getting its color.

classes.name: PeripheralController::RgbLight
classes.description: Represents an RGB light with separate red, green, blue components.

classes.name: PeripheralController::MultiColorLight
classes.description: Represents a multi-color light with separate intensities for red, green, and blue.

classes.name: PeripheralController::PlayerIdLight
classes.description: Light indicating player ID, allowing setting and getting the current player ID.

methods.name: getRawLightBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the scaled brightness of a raw light by its ID.

methods.name: setRawLightBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of a raw light by its ID.

methods.name: setLightColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a specific light, delegating to the appropriate light object.

methods.name: getLightColor
methods.description: Retrieves the current color of a specific light.

methods.name: setLightPlayerId
methods.description: Sets the player ID for a PlayerIdLight.

methods.name: getLightPlayerId
methods.description: Gets the current player ID from a PlayerIdLight.

methods.name: populateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Populates device info with batteries and lights information.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the input controller, including lights and batteries.

methods.name: configureBattries
methods.description: Initializes battery objects based on raw battery IDs.

methods.name: configureLights
methods.description: Initializes and configures lights, including RGB, player ID, and other raw lights.

methods.name: getBatteryCapacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of a specified battery.

methods.name: getBatteryStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specified battery.

methods.name: getEventHubId
methods.description: Returns the EventHub ID associated with the device.
